name: 33315 · Ft Lauderdale, FL
findings: ZIP 33315 (Ft Lauderdale) has 61 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33315 (Ft Lauderdale) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
53% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33315 (Ft Lauderdale) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
